2226-2397-8306.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control tap for at least {2}{R}{G}{W} plus half the cost of your self-bouncing creature.
2226-2397-8306.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters, its ability triggers twice through Panharmonicon.
Resolve the first Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Keymaster Rogue by paying its mana cost.
When Keymaster Rogue enters, its ability triggers twice, causing you to return itself and Zacama to your hand.
Repeat.

4289-4770-5223-6090.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it and Arahbo trigger.
Resolve the Arahbo trigger, creating a 1/1 Cat creature token.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Cat token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

4213-4687-5296.notablePrerequisites: Workhorse has at least four counters on it.
4213-4687-5296.description:
Activate Hankyu by tapping Gilder Bairn, producing its effect.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on Workhorse.
Activate Workhorse as many times as necessary by removing counters from it, adding at least three mana.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite counters on Workhorse, you may instead double the counters on any other permanents.

requires.n: Artifact Creature that is a Gnome and/or Artificer

2527-4073-4247-4917--75.notablePrerequisites:
Jan Jansen and the additional Gnome or Artificer do not have a +1/+1 counter on them.
You control at least one additional artifact creature.
2527-4073-4247-4917--75.description:
Activate Jan Jansen's first ability by tapping it and sacrificing another artifact creature you control except the Gnome or Artificer.
Jan Jansen triggers, causing it and creatures you control that share a creature type with it to get +2/+0 and undying until end of turn.
Resolve the Jan Jansen ability, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Jan Jansen.
When Jan Jansen dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability
Activate Jan Jansen's first ability by tapping it and sacrificing the Gnome or Artificer.
When the Gnome or Artificer dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Jan Jansen ability, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Retribution of the Ancients by paying {B} and removing the +1/+1 counter from Jan Jansen and the other Gnome or Artificer, giving a creature -2/-2 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 4.

requires.n: Creature with MV>=4 that has a generic mana cost

866-3899-5220--66.notablePrerequisites: You have cast your commander from the command zone enough times to cast the creature with MV>=4  for its blitz cost by paying {0}.
866-3899-5220--66.description:
Cast the creature with MV>=4 for its blitz cost by paying {0}.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the creature.
When the creature dies, it and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting it from your graveyard on top of your library.
Resolve the creature's trigger, causing you to draw it from the top of your library.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability
Repeat.

4321-5777-8095.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
4321-5777-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing a Food.
Camellia triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token and a Food artifact token.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability
Repeat.

4247-5702-7084.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

3703-3899-7084.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Sporemound triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

618-3967-4681.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, targeting Karmic Guide
Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Kiki-Jiki
Resolve the Kiki-Jiki ability, creating a token copy of Karmic Guide with haste.
When the Karmic Guide token enters, it triggers, returning Kiki-JIki from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

147-2034-7682.notablePrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard with mana value 4 or less.
147-2034-7682.description:
Cast Lively Dirge by paying {1}{B} plus an additional {2} to select its second mode, targeting a card in your graveyard.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Lively Dirge.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Lively Dirge
Resolve the Lively Dirge copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

3967-6972-7236.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Towering Titan.
When Towering Titan dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

4050-4677-7084.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Zendikar's Roil triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

413-911-6972--112.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Propeller Pioneer.
When Propeller Pioneer dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Propeller Pioneer enters, its fabricate ability and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Propeller Pioneer ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.
413-911-6972--112.notes: The chosen anthem effect must boost Propeller Pioneer's toughness by at least 1 so it doesn't die from the -1/-1 counter.

427-1978-2392.notablePrerequisites: You've drawn three or more cards this turn.
427-1978-2392.description:
Activate Kydele by tapping it, adding at least {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Kydele.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: with four or more charge counters on it

647-1402-2218-4763.description:
Cast Diamond Lion by paying {2}.
When Diamond Lion enters, Ronin Warclub triggers, attaching itself to Diamond Lion.
Activate Diamond Lion by tapping it, sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding three mana of any color.
When Diamond Lion dies, Koll triggers, returning Diamond Lion from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.exileCardState: with a memory counter on it

1308-3951-5703-6646.easyPrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr
1308-3951-5703-6646.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker, triggering its ability, creating two tapped and attacking copies of Éomer.
Put all but one Éomer token into your graveyard due to the legend rule, causing you to get at least one Éomer trigger, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
At the end of your combat phase, Altaïr triggers, causing you to exile the Éomer token.
Repeat each combat phase.

64-2034-4871-6476.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two opponents that each have a creature card that will enter the battlefield with greater than 0 toughness in their graveyard.
64-2034-4871-6476.description:
Cast Afterlife from the Loam by paying at most {5}{B}{B}{B}, returning Warden of the Eye and at least two other creatures from graveyards to the battlefield under your control.
When Warden of the Eye enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Afterlife from the Loam from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Ashnod's Altar four times by sacrificing three of the creatures returned in step 1, adding six {C}.
When the creatures die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers four times, creating three Treasure tokens.
Activate the three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

2169-4929-5224.description:
Activate Zameck Guildmage's first ability by paying {G}{U}, causing each creature you control to enter the battlefield this turn with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Cryptic Trilobite by paying {0}, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Zameck Guildmage.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Cryptic Trilobite.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Cryptic Trilobite dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Together Forever, returning Cryptic Trilobite from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

2793-3743-4067-5089-6441.manaNeeded: {5} available, with an additional {5} every fourth turn
2793-3743-4067-5089-6441.description:
Activate Osgir by paying {5}, tapping it and exiling Ugin's Nexus from your graveyard, creating four token copies of Ugin's Nexus.
Put three of the Ugin's Nexus tokens into exile due to the legend rule and their replacement effects, causing you to take three extra turns after this one.
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, choosing to do nothing.
Move to your next extra turn.
Repeat from step 3 one additional time.
Activate Karn's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, returning Ugin's Nexus from exile to your hand.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Ugin's Nexus.
Move to your last extra turn.
Repeat.

2558-5330-5687-5689.description:
Activate Atog by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Skittering Precursor triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield as a 1/1 due to Raiders' Spoils, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Eldrazi Spawn.
Resolve the Atog ability, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

4384-4499-4659.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Treebeard.
When Treebeard enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, creating two Food tokens.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing the Foods, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
4384-4499-4659.notes: Once you have infinite Foods, you may instead sacrifice them to their own abilities.

1409-2895-3756-5478.manaNeeded: {1}{G}{U} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
1409-2895-3756-5478.description:
Cast Uro by paying {1}{G}{U}
When Uro enters the battlefield, its first and second abilities trigger, as well as Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, pairing it and Uro.
Resolve the second Uro trigger, causing you to draw a card, gain 3 life, and put Izzet Boilerworks from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Izzet Boilerworks enters untapped due to Spelunking, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Izzet Boilerworks by tapping it, adding {U}{R}.
Resolve the Izzet Boilerworks trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Uro by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.exileCardState: with a kick counter on it

249-4377-4380.notablePrerequisites:
Zethi does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least three Islands.
An opponent cannot block and kill Zethi.
249-4377-4380.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons with buyback by paying {4}{U}{U} and sacrificing three Islands, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and return Walk the Aeons to your hand.
Declare Zethi as an attacker.
Zethi's second ability triggers, causing you to pay {2}{W}{W} to cast a copy of Sudden Salvation.
Resolve the copy of Sudden Salvation, returning the three Islands that were sacrificed from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat each turn.

2051-2546-3872-4566.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two additional land cards in hand.
2051-2546-3872-4566.description:
Activate Barren Moor's cycling ability by paying {B} and discarding it.
 Surly Badgersaur's second ability triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Barren Moor ability, causing you to mill three cards and return Life from the Loam from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Land's Edge by discarding a land card.
Surly Badgersaur's second ability triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Land's Edge ability, dealing 2 damage to an opponent.
Repeat from step 4 one additional time.
Activate the three Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}{G}.
Cast Life from the Loam by paying {1}{G}, returning Barren Moor and two other lands from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1479-3585-4543.notablePrerequisites: You have a land card in hand.
1479-3585-4543.description:
Play a land card from your hand.
Kodama, Trench Behemoth and Greensleeves trigger.
If the land played was a basic land, you may activate it by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield from your hand.
Resolve the Trench Behemoth trigger, targeting any creature an opponent controls.
Resolve the Greensleeves trigger, creating a 3/3 Badger creature token.
The Badger enters the battlefield, triggering Kodama.
Holding priority, activate Trench Behemoth by returning a land from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Trench Behemoth.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting a land onto the battlefield from your hand.
Trench Behemoth and Greensleeves trigger.
Repeat from step 5.

728-3490-4474.notablePrerequisites:
Paradise Mantle attached to Grimgrin.
Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional creature.
728-3490-4474.description:
Activate Grimgrin by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing a creature, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

3232-3659-4050-4763.description:
Cast Fireblade Charger by paying {R}.
Fireblade Charger enters the battlefield, triggering Obsidian Battle-Axe, attaching it to Fireblade Charger.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Fireblade Charger, adding {R}.
Fireblade Charger dies, triggering itself and Koll.
Resolve Fireblade Charger's trigger, dealing 3 damage to any target.
Resolve Koll's trigger, returning Fireblade Charger from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

579-2661-4484-5256.notablePrerequisites:
Gwenna does not have summoning sickness.
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich had died this turn.
579-2661-4484-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Ebondeath, causing target player to mill cards equal to Ebondeath's power.
Activate Gwenna by tapping it, adding {2}{B}{B} that can only be spent to cast creature spells or activate abilities of creatures.
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {2}{B}{B}.
Gwenna triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and untapping it.
Repeat.

202-429-4067.description:
Activate Pristine Talisman by tapping it, adding {C} and causing you to draw a card due to Lich.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Pristine Talisman.
Repeat.

613-3718.notablePrerequisites: You control an indestructible noncreature permanent.
613-3718.description:
Cast Chain of Acid for {3}{G} targeting an indestructible noncreature permanent you control.
Professor Onyx triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life and you to gain 2 life.
Resolve Chain of Acid, failing to destroy the target and copying Chain of Acid targeting the same permanent.
Repeat from step 2.

784-1721-4872.notablePrerequisites: Opponents can not block Silas Renn.
784-1721-4872.description:
Cast Time Warp to take an extra turn.
Pay {5}, tap Codex Shredder and sacrifice it to return Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Attack with Silas Renn, dealing combat damage.
Cast Codex Shredder from your graveyard.
Pass the turn.
Repeat.

1367-2853.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Thought Lash's cumulative upkeep ability triggers; decline to pay the cost and sacrifice Thought Lash.
Thought Lash's second ability triggers, causing you to exile all cards from your library.
Cast Nexus of Fate by paying {5}{U}{U}, taking an extra turn after this one and shuffling Nexus of Fate into your empty library.
Draw Nexus of Fate on your next draw step.
Repeat from step 3 each turn.
